2027-02-02.title: Mayaltho · The Entrance of our Lord into the Temple
readings: The Spirit rests on the shoot of Jesse
Christ entered the Holy Place with his own blood
2027-02-02.verse: Master, now you are dismissing your servant in peace, according to your word; for my eyes have seen your salvation.

2027-02-07.title: Kothine Sunday · First Sunday of the Great Fast
readings: Return to me with all your heart
Is not this the fast that I choose?
In Antioch they were first called Christians
2027-02-07.verse: Jesus did this, the first of his signs, in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.

2027-02-14.title: Garbo Sunday · The Healing of the Leper
readings: Naaman is cleansed in the Jordan
They shall seek the Lord their God
Jesus touches and cleanses a leper
2027-02-14.verse: Lord, if you choose, you can make me clean.

2027-02-21.title: M'shario Sunday · The Healing of the Paralytic
readings: The song of Moses as a witness
They hear your words but do not do them
Woe to those who call evil good
Signs and wonders by the apostles
While we were still sinners, Christ died for us
Four friends lower the paralytic through the roof

2027-02-28.title: Knanoitho Sunday · The Canaanite Woman
readings: Thus far the Lord has helped us
A house of prayer for all peoples
2027-02-28.verse: Woman, great is your faith! Let it be done for you as you wish.

2027-02-01.title: Monday after Aneede Sunday
readings: Rescued from darkness into the kingdom of his beloved Son
Pray then in this way: Our Father
2027-02-01.verse: And forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.

2027-02-03.title: Wednesday after Aneede Sunday · Mar Shem'on and Morth Hanna
readings: Simeon and Anna meet the child in the temple
2027-02-03.verse: At that moment she came, and began to praise God and to speak about the child to all who were looking for the redemption of Jerusalem.

2027-02-04.title: Thursday after Aneede Sunday · St John de Britto
readings: I am not ashamed of the gospel
2027-02-04.verse: For I am not ashamed of the gospel; it is the power of God for salvation to everyone who has faith, to the Jew first and also to the Greek.

2027-02-05.title: Friday after Aneede Sunday
readings: Written down to instruct us; God is faithful
If the world hates you, it hated me first
2027-02-05.verse: If the world hates you, be aware that it hated me before it hated you.

2027-02-06.title: Saturday after Aneede Sunday
readings: Rich in good works, generous and ready to share
The rich fool: rich toward God
2027-02-06.verse: So it is with those who store up treasures for themselves but are not rich toward God.

2027-02-08.title: Monday of the first week of the Great Fast · Shubkono
readings: Forgiving one another, as God in Christ has forgiven you
2027-02-08.verse: and be kind to one another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, as God in Christ has forgiven you.

2027-02-09.title: Tuesday of the first week of the Great Fast
readings: The covenant sacrifice: Abram keeps watch
No condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus
2027-02-09.verse: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

2027-02-10.title: Wednesday of the first week of the Great Fast · Anniversary of the Syro-Malankara Major Archiepiscopal Church
readings: A flaming torch passes between the pieces
I press on toward the goal
But who do you say that I am?
2027-02-10.verse: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “The Messiah of God.”

2027-02-11.title: Thursday of the first week of the Great Fast · Our Lady of Lourdes
readings: Sarai, Hagar and a plan made without God
Your life is hidden with Christ in God
2027-02-11.verse: for he has looked with favor on the lowliness of his servant. Surely, from now on all generations will call me blessed;

2027-02-12.title: Friday of the first week of the Great Fast
readings: The God who sees Hagar in the wilderness
The law written on their hearts
Everyone who acknowledges me before others
2027-02-12.verse: And I tell you, everyone who acknowledges me before others, the Son of Man also will acknowledge before the angels of God;

2027-02-13.title: Saturday of the first week of the Great Fast · Mar Aprem and Mar Theodore; Prophet Haggai
readings: Walk before me, and be blameless
The word of God is living and active
2027-02-13.verse: Everyone then who hears these words of mine and acts on them will be like a wise man who built his house on rock.

2027-02-15.title: Monday of the second week of the Great Fast
readings: The sign of the covenant in the flesh
Devote yourselves to prayer; let your speech be gracious
Do not worry; strive first for the kingdom
2027-02-15.verse: But strive first for the kingdom of God and his righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well.

2027-02-16.title: Tuesday of the second week of the Great Fast
readings: Sarah shall be her name; Isaac is promised
By grace you have been saved through faith
You will know them by their fruits
2027-02-16.verse: For by grace you have been saved through faith, and this is not your own doing; it is the gift of God

2027-02-17.title: Wednesday of the second week of the Great Fast
readings: Christ, in whom are hidden all the treasures of wisdom
The Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head
2027-02-17.verse: But Jesus said to him, “Follow me, and let the dead bury their own dead.”

2027-02-18.title: Thursday of the second week of the Great Fast
readings: Abraham welcomes three guests at Mamre
We are the temple of the living God
The wedding banquet and the wedding robe
2027-02-18.verse: For we are the temple of the living God; as God said, “I will live in them and walk among them, and I will be their God, and they shall be my people.

2027-02-19.title: Friday of the second week of the Great Fast · Mar Ishaq
readings: Sarah laughs: is anything too wonderful for the Lord?
The surpassing value of knowing Christ Jesus my Lord
No one will snatch them out of my hand
2027-02-19.verse: Is anything too wonderful for the Lord? At the set time I will return to you, in due season, and Sarah shall have a son.

2027-02-20.title: Saturday of the second week of the Great Fast
readings: Shall I hide from Abraham what I am about to do?
The goodness and loving kindness of God our Savior appeared
Where your treasure is, there your heart will be also
2027-02-20.verse: Do not be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the kingdom.

2027-02-22.title: Monday of the third week of the Great Fast · The See of St Peter at Antioch
readings: Remember your leaders; Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever
2027-02-22.verse: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.

2027-02-23.title: Tuesday of the third week of the Great Fast · St Polycarp of Smyrna
readings: Lot shelters the angels in Sodom
Come to me, all you that are weary
2027-02-23.verse: Come to me, all you that are weary and are carrying heavy burdens, and I will give you rest.

2027-02-24.title: Wednesday of the third week of the Great Fast · The Finding of the Head of St John the Baptist
readings: Lot lingers, and the angels take him by the hand
There is no one who is righteous, not even one
The death of John the Baptist
2027-02-24.verse: But he lingered; so the men seized him and his wife and his two daughters by the hand, the Lord being merciful to him, and they brought him out and left him outside the city.

2027-02-25.title: Thursday of the third week of the Great Fast · Blessed Rani Maria
readings: Lot's wife looks back; God remembered Abraham
Sheep in the midst of wolves
2027-02-25.verse: But we have this treasure in clay jars, so that it may be made clear that this extraordinary power belongs to God and does not come from us.

2027-02-26.title: Friday of the third week of the Great Fast
readings: Lot and his daughters in the cave
God's kindness is meant to lead you to repentance
Pray to your Father who is in secret
2027-02-26.verse: Or do you despise the riches of his kindness and forbearance and patience? Do you not realize that God’s kindness is meant to lead you to repentance?

2027-02-27.title: Saturday of the third week of the Great Fast
readings: “She is my sister”: God guards Sarah
Doers of the law; conscience bears witness
The Holy Spirit will teach you what to say
2027-02-27.verse: Then God said to him in the dream, “Yes, I know that you did this in the integrity of your heart; furthermore it was I who kept you from sinning against me. Therefore I did not let you touch her.
